key_insight: This study protocol will explore genetic variants linked to portopulmonary hypertension (PoPH) in patients with congenital portosystemic shunts (CPSS).
clinical_relevance: Findings could eventually improve PoPH risk assessment and inform elective shunt-closure decisions, but clinical utility is not yet established.
method: International, multicentre recruitment through the International Registry of Congenital Portosystemic Shunts.
Whole-genome sequencing with targeted and genome-wide searches for potentially pathogenic variants.
ACMG variant classification plus trio and family segregation analyses to assess inheritance.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a planned, predominantly paediatric genomic study; it reports no sample size, genetic findings or predictive performance.
watch_item: This is an exploratory genomics protocol, not an AI evaluation; any discovered associations will require validation before clinical use.
paper_title: Genetic hallmarks of patients with congenital portosystemic shunts and portopulmonary hypertension: protocol for a multicentre exploratory study
